title: Build the tably deterministic ASCII table renderer from its sealed spec
goal: Implement the tably rendering library exactly as written in assets/gc-401/SPEC.md, from scratch, at workspace/gc-401/tably.py. The spec pins an exact layout algorithm (width computation, max_col capping, ellipsis truncation, three alignment modes with a defined center-bias, separator geometry) and normative golden outputs, so near-miss renderings fail byte-for-byte. Plan the geometry rules, implement, diff failing goldens character by character, and iterate against the sealed suite until every byte matches.
process_expectations: A plan artifact workspace/gc-401/plan.md exists before implementation, deriving each golden example from the layout rules by hand.
workspace/gc-401/runs.log records every sealed-suite invocation with its summary line (intermediate RED allowed, final GREEN).
Byte-level diffs of failing golden tests are captured in the log, identified per test node id, with the geometry rule that was wrong.
Recovery after RED is shown as diagnosis -> fix -> re-run; the sealed test file is never edited.
